$comment: Always on. Code picks the rule; this file gives its level and the reason the room keeps.

git-alias-semantic-unverified.reason: git runs a subcommand the room cannot read: an alias it cannot see, or a word known only at run time

branch-dynamic-token.reason: git branch has a word that may expand into a delete or force flag

checkout-discard.reason: git checkout -- <path> throws away uncommitted changes to the path

checkout-ref-discard.reason: git checkout <ref> -- <path> overwrites the path with another revision

checkout-discard-cwd.reason: git checkout . throws away every uncommitted change below the folder

reflog-expire-now.reason: git reflog expire now drops the record that lets lost commits be found

checkout-force.reason: git checkout -f throws away local changes to tracked files

switch-discard.reason: git switch --discard-changes (or -f) throws away local changes

rm-force.reason: git rm -f deletes files together with their uncommitted changes

update-ref-delete.reason: git update-ref -d deletes a ref, like git branch -D

read-tree-reset.reason: git read-tree --reset -u overwrites the working tree, like git reset --hard

show-redirect-overwrite-source.reason: git show <ref>:<path> > <path> overwrites the file with another revision

restore-worktree.reason: git restore without --staged throws away working-tree changes

restore-worktree-explicit.reason: git restore --worktree throws away working-tree changes

reset-hard.reason: git reset --hard throws away every uncommitted change

reset-merge.reason: git reset --merge can throw away local changes

clean-force.reason: git clean -f deletes untracked files for good

push-force-long.reason: git push --force can overwrite commits on the remote

push-force-short.reason: git push -f can overwrite commits on the remote

push-force-refspec.reason: a + refspec forces that ref on the remote

branch-force-delete.reason: git branch -D (or -f, -M, -C) deletes or moves a branch without a merge check

stash-drop.reason: git stash drop deletes a stash

stash-clear.reason: git stash clear deletes every stash

lfs-migrate-rewrite.reason: git lfs migrate import or export rewrites history

lfs-prune.reason: git lfs prune deletes local LFS objects

lfs-uninstall.reason: git lfs uninstall removes the LFS filters and hooks

rm-rf-root-home.reason: rm -rf on the system, a home folder, or a home's settings

rm-r-f-separate-root-home.reason: rm -r -f on the system, a home folder, or a home's settings

rm-recursive-force-root-home.reason: rm --recursive --force on the system, a home folder, or a home's settings

rm-recursive-root-home.reason: rm -r on the system, a home folder, or a home's settings

rm-rf-general.reason: rm -rf removes a folder and everything in it for good

rm-r-f-separate.reason: rm -r -f removes a folder and everything in it for good

rm-recursive-force-long.reason: rm --recursive --force removes a folder and everything in it for good

rm-recursive-general.reason: rm -r removes a folder and everything in it

rm-generated.reason: rm -r removes a folder git ignores in this project

rm-bare-glob.reason: rm * removes whatever the shell matches here

rm-bare-glob-root.reason: rm /* removes the entries at the root of the system

rm-protected-file.reason: rm on a key, a credential, a shell startup file, or the repository's own state

rm-glob-home.reason: rm with an unquoted pattern under a home folder

rm-recursive-unverified.reason: a command known only at run time gets the arguments of a destructive rm

cp-sensitive-then-delete.reason: cp -a from a system or home path into a temp folder, then rm -rf of it

ln-symlink-sensitive-then-delete.reason: a link to a system or home path, then rm -rf through it

rsync-sensitive-then-delete.reason: rsync -a from a system or home path into a temp folder, then rm -rf of it

rsync-delete-sensitive-dest.reason: rsync --delete into the system or a whole home folder

find-delete-root-home.reason: find -delete or -exec rm reaching the system or a home folder

find-delete-general.reason: find -delete or -exec rm removes every file it matches

unlink-root-home.reason: unlink on a system or home path

unlink-general.reason: unlink removes a file for good

truncate-zero-root-home.reason: truncate sets the size of a system or home file

shred-root-home.reason: shred overwrites a system or home file

tar-remove-files-root-home.reason: tar --remove-files on system or home paths

tar-remove-files-general.reason: tar --remove-files removes the files it archives

dd-overwrite-root-home.reason: dd writes over a system or home file

mv-sensitive-source-root-home.reason: mv touching the system or a home folder's top

mv-dynamic-path.reason: mv with a path known only at run time

credential-file-write.reason: a write into a key, a credential, or a shell startup file

git-internals-write.reason: a write into the repository's .git folder

redirect-truncate-root-home.reason: > replaces a system or home file

redirect-truncate-dynamic-path.reason: > into a path known only at run time

sed-exec-unverified.reason: sed runs a shell command the room cannot read

interpreter-runs-dynamic-shell.reason: a script runs a shell line it builds at run time

tar-exec-unverified.reason: tar runs a helper command the room cannot read
